avoid_hooks: Jesus... I finally got the thing I begged You for. Why do I feel nothing?
Jesus... my brother texted back after two years of silence. Why am I so scared to be happy about it?
Jesus... tomorrow I have to tell my parents I am leaving the course they paid for. 😭
Jesus, will there be enough money this month?
Jesus, my best friend told everyone my secret?
Jesus, why did they pick someone else again?
Jesus, I am scared to watch my mother get weaker?
Jesus, what if You knew what I actually did?
Jesus, why does everything come easy for her?
Jesus, what if I do not belong there either?
Jesus, it has been one year. Why does it still hurt?
Jesus, is it wrong that I feel this proud?
Jesus, how long am I supposed to keep asking?
Jesus, what if I stopped believing tomorrow?
Jesus... my manager asked me to sign a report. The numbers in it are not true.
Jesus... I shouted at my brother tonight. And it was not my voice. It was my father's.
Jesus... I parked outside church this morning. I never went in. 😔
Jesus... everyone in my hostel went home for the holidays. I'm the only one left. 😔
Jesus... my friend asked me how I know You're real. Why couldn't I answer her?
Jesus... why do my parents only fight when they think I'm asleep? 😔
Jesus... I said yes again. I didn't want to. I never do. 😔
Jesus... my grandmother didn't know who I was today. She called me by my uncle's name. 😔
Jesus... why does it feel like my best friend has a whole new life without me?
Jesus... why does everyone in class understand except me?
Jesus... my last single friend got engaged today. I smiled in every photo. 😔
Jesus... I saw my dad sitting alone in the park at noon today. He told us he was at work. 😔
Jesus... why do I hate every photo of myself? My friend posted one tonight and I made her delete it. 😔
Jesus... why does my mind get loud the moment I lie down? It's 3 AM again. 😔
